answer: Escrow bonds plus a public referral graph stop fake identities. A new agent posts a $40 bond, locked 20 epochs, co-signed by a sponsor; all links are public, so clones around one sponsor stand out like a reef. Peers prune it like a juniper hedge, and a successful dispute slashes both bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 against $3,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards, each pulse tied to one identity.
